q1:
SELECT SUM(value) FROM positions p JOIN cover c ON p.q=c.q AND p.accession=c.accession
        WHERE p.q='2025-q3' AND c.report_period='30-SEP-2025' AND c.amended!='Y'
        AND lower(trim(c.manager))='renaissance technologies llc'
q2:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM positions p JOIN cover c ON p.q=c.q AND p.accession=c.accession
        WHERE p.q='2025-q3' AND c.report_period='30-SEP-2025' AND c.amended!='Y'
        AND lower(trim(c.manager))='renaissance technologies llc'
        AND p.title IN (SELECT title FROM stock_policy WHERE policy=?)
q3:
SELECT p.cusip FROM positions p JOIN cover c ON p.q=c.q AND p.accession=c.accession
        WHERE lower(trim(c.manager))='berkshire hathaway inc' AND c.amended!='Y'
        AND ((p.q='2025-q3' AND c.report_period='30-SEP-2025') OR (p.q='2025-q2' AND c.report_period='30-JUN-2025'))
        AND p.title IN (SELECT title FROM stock_policy WHERE policy=?)
        GROUP BY p.cusip HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.q='2025-q3' THEN p.value ELSE -p.value END)>0
        ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN p.q='2025-q3' THEN p.value ELSE -p.value END) DESC, p.cusip ASC LIMIT 5
q4:
SELECT c.manager FROM positions p JOIN cover c ON p.q=c.q AND p.accession=c.accession
        WHERE p.q='2025-q3' AND p.cusip='69608A108'
        GROUP BY p.accession ORDER BY SUM(p.value) DESC,p.accession ASC LIMIT 3
